verdict.rationale: AWS explicitly documents an official pricing calculator (calculator.aws) and cost-estimation/management tooling (Cost Explorer API, AWS Budgets, Free Tier credit details), giving founders a way to estimate costs before committing. However, the evidence pack lacks direct citations of per-service public pricing pages (e.g., EC2/S3 pricing pages) themselves, and multiple community reports describe real difficulty predicting/understanding actual charges despite published pricing, tempering confidence that estimates map cleanly to real bills. Missing for 10: direct evidence of per-service pricing pages, and stronger corroboration that calculator estimates match real-world billing outcomes.
